content: Threshold config UX for non-technical users: (1) Named presets ('Conservador', 'Moderado', 'Agressivo') are the table-stakes entry point — non-technical users pick a profile, not numbers; (2) Sliders with live impact preview beat raw number inputs — show effect in real units ('Se meta de margem = 20%, 3 anúncios entram em alerta'); (3) Guardrails = hard bounds that prevent nonsensical values (margin target cannot be > 100%, TACoS target cannot be < 1%); (4) Description text next to each threshold explains what it controls in plain language; (5) Advanced mode (hidden by default) exposes raw numbers for power users. The best-practice sequence: preset → tweak slider → preview impact → save. Rollback/undo is critical safety net.
